meta_data.base_class: Delete a <message> by message ID - refers to various types of social or communication messages.

tool_template.name: delete_<class>_message
tool_template.description: Delete a <class> message based on its message ID.

message_id.description: The ID of the <class> message to be deleted.

timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the <class> message was created, in Unix format.

softDelete.description: A flag indicating whether the <class> message should be soft deleted, allowing for potential recovery.

reasonForDeletion.description: An note providing a reason for the deletion of the <class> message.

initiator.description: The identifier of the user or system initiating the deletion of the <class> message.
